prompt:
Create ONE exquisitely detailed landscape educational reference image for a premium backend engineering learning service.
This is a fully developed precise technical learning scene, not an icon, pictogram, emoji, generic marketing illustration or decorative server collage.
Craftsmanship: high-DPI institutional engineering terminal, very fine matte navy glass surface, subtle micro-grain, restrained cyan and warm gold accents, crisp light text, perfectly aligned grid, disciplined line weights, calm density, substantial readable typography.
Composition: one coherent left-to-right diagram with large readable labels and a narrow explanatory status strip below; technical relationship and current state have priority. Keep all labels inside safe margins. No browser shell, no logos, no watermark, no fake measured telemetry, no green PASS badges. English typography only; do not invent source code or real hashes.
Output one opaque landscape image around 1672x941; final deliverable is converted to JPG at native resolution.
Scene: Title "Which revision did the check actually test?" Badge "ILLUSTRATIVE MODEL - NO REMOTE PR". Left two-thirds: show a GitHub pull_request default path for an OPEN MERGEABLE PR: base B1 and head H2 converge into a test merge M1; highlight "GITHUB_REF: refs/pull/<N>/merge" and "GITHUB_SHA: M1". An adjacent clear alternate lane "Explicit head-only checkout" points to H2 and says "github.event.pull_request.head.sha". H1 is a faded earlier head with an old check result, disconnected from the current M1 result; label "An old result is not a result for the new target". Right third: two independent selected gates: "Required check accepted for current target" and "Required approval satisfied". A compact three-row table: accepted check yes + approval no -> waiting; check no + approval yes -> waiting; both yes -> these two gates satisfied. Footer must say "Other rules may still block merge. Strict base freshness and stale-approval dismissal depend on repository settings." Avoid claiming skipped or neutral required checks can never be accepted; use the word accepted rather than only green/success. Small short scope "B1 / H1 / H2 / M1 are symbolic identifiers, not observed SHAs." No actual PR/CI screenshots or fake success badge.

Scene: Title "Auto-sync has separate controls". Badge "POLICY MODEL - NO ARGO CD RUN". Four large horizontally aligned sections with short readable labels: 1 Activation has three rows "automated absent -> off", "automated: {} or enabled omitted/null inside it -> on", "enabled: false -> off". Make absent mean the automated OBJECT is absent, while omitted enabled means the KEY INSIDE an existing automated object. 2 Resource removal shows "prune: false (default)" and a Git-removed resource staying live, caption "Auto-sync alone does not promise deletion". 3 Live drift shows "selfHeal: false (default)" and desired/live difference, caption "Live drift alone does not trigger default auto-sync"; a short small note "Other sources can trigger sync in multi-source apps". 4 Failed revision shows "same SHA + parameters failed" and "no new default auto-sync retry"; a separate box "syncPolicy.retry: explicit retry/backoff policy" so retries are not declared impossible. Bottom strip has "Sync and health are separate" and "Documented reconciliation default: 120s + up to60s jitter" followed by short "Configurable polling setting, not measured completion time". A final scope footer "Auto-sync enabled apps have rollback-command restrictions. No cluster changes or rollback were performed." Avoid suggesting every sync completes within180s, instant drift repair, one universal GitOps retry algorithm or that self-heal/prune are enabled by default.
